text.p: Tropical cyclone Drena is weakening as it southeastward in the Southwestern Pacific. Conditions continue to improve across New Caledonia. Drena will now threaten mostly shipping during the next 24 hours and that threat will be minimal as it begins to become extratropical. It should be an extratropical storm as it tracks into the North Island of New Zealand later in the period with gusty winds and moderate to locally heavy rains.

Tropical Cyclone Fabriola, with 35 mph winds, is off the coast of southern Madagascar and dissipating. Heavy rains continue to result in flash flooding across the mountainous terrain of southern Madagascar. Conditions will improve over the next 24 hours as the storm dissipates off shore.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
